search.title: Search
search.filtered: filtered — press the facet again to clear
search.junkScope: Search does not reach your mail server's own {folder} folder — ohmail does not mirror it.
search.junkScopeUnnamed: Search does not reach your mail server's own junk folder — ohmail does not mirror it.
search.partReach: A part inside a word is looked for in subjects, senders, recipients and attachment names, not in the message text.
search.scopeIndexing: Your recent mail is still being read, so more results will appear.
search.scopeWholeAtLeast: Searched your whole mailbox — at least {total, number} matched
search.scopeWholeAbout: Searched your whole mailbox — about {total, number} matched
search.scopeUnanswered: Your server did not answer, so these are from the recent mail this device holds.
search.scopeFailed: Your server could not run this search, so these are from the recent mail this device holds.
search.saidReading: Your recent mail is still being read, so more results will appear.
search.saidIndexing: Older mail is still being indexed, {percent}% done.
search.saidAbout: About {total} matched in your whole mailbox.
search.saidAtLeast: At least {total} matched in your whole mailbox.
search.saidMirror: ohmail Cloud cannot be reached, so only the mail on this computer was searched.
search.saidSynced: Only the mail synced so far was searched. The rest of your mail has not synced yet.
search.saidBounded: These are the {count} best matches. Sort by date to walk them all.
search.saidJunk: Search does not reach your mail server’s Junk folder, because ohmail keeps no copy of it.
search.saidJunkNamed: Search does not reach your mail server’s {folder} folder, because ohmail keeps no copy of it.
search.saidPart: A part inside a word is looked for in subjects, senders, recipients and file names, not in the message text.
search.addressArchive: {count, plural, one {1 in your whole mailbox} other {# in your whole mailbox}}
search.addressArchiveBySender: {count, plural, one {1 in your whole mailbox (by sender)} other {# in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveSynced: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far} other {# in the mail synced so far}}
search.addressArchiveAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in your whole mailbox}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderSynced: {count, plural, one {1 in the mail synced so far (by sender)} other {# in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in your whole mailbox (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveSyncedAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderSyncedAtLeast: {count, plural, other {at least # in the mail synced so far (by sender)}}
search.addressArchiveBySenderWhy: Your whole mailbox is searched by sender only, so older mail sent to this address is not counted yet.
search.addressArchiveNoRecipientsWhy: This is the recent mail sent to this address. Older mail sent to it cannot be listed yet.
search.addressOffline: ohmail Cloud cannot be reached, so this is the mail on this computer.
